project_name: DigiLib Unesa Digital Repository & Library System

image_urls.description: Modern digital library interior with tall bookshelves and study desks
Academic university shield symbol or signage

key_functionalities: Catalog browsing with advanced search and multi-faculty filters
Google Sheets & Google Apps Script sync status dashboard and backend management
Member authentication & role-based access (Member vs Admin)
Book & Thesis detail view with dual abstract (ID/EN) and simulated PDF/Manuscript viewer
Borrowing/reservation workflow with due date tracking
Comprehensive Admin Panel for managing catalog, members, and transactions
instructions_to_main_agent: Build a fully responsive e-library portal mirroring digilib.unesa.ac.id with Google Apps Script & Google Sheets integration layer simulation, member portal, catalog search, book detail with PDF/abstract viewer, borrowing workflow, and admin management dashboard. Ensure all interactive elements include appropriate data-testid attributes and adhere to E1 design principles.
